known_facts_book1: The place Peter's mother forbids her children from entering, because their father had a fatal accident there.
Grows lettuces, French beans, radishes, parsley, young cabbages, potatoes and onions.
Peter squeezes under its gate to get in, and slips back under the same gate to escape at the end.
Contains a cucumber frame, a gooseberry net, a tool-shed, a window, a wheelbarrow and a pond where Mr. McGregor fills his water-cans.
The scene of the whole chase: Peter loses both his shoes and his jacket here before escaping into the wood outside.

known_relations_book1.Mr. McGregor: Its owner and gardener; tends the vegetables and chases Peter through it.
known_relations_book1.Peter: Trespasses in it to eat vegetables, and is chased through it for most of the book.
